description: List your own tokens (never a secret): type, name, status (active / expiring / expired / revoked / never_used / stale), last 4 characters, scopes or permissions, repository, expiry, last use (time, IP, client), use count and rotation state. `type` is pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_), or omit it for all three (types your token's scopes cannot read are listed under `omitted`). PATs need 'user' scope to read; repository and deploy tokens need 'repo'.

type.description: Token type: pat (personal access token, glc_), repo (repository token, gcft_) or deploy (deploy token, gcdt_). Omit for all.

name: gluecron_list_tokens
